scope: Fresh native image writer mediation and independent query-only BPF/platform-daemon identity mechanisms; not installed hardware authority qualification
implementation: Only pinned fresh-image login1 and both power-profiles aliases are transformed. Ordinary SetBrightness and profile mutation delivery is removed, root delivery and explicit ordinary property reads are preserved. Fixed Polkit and udev rules prevent the ambient desktop writer path

The read-only verifier pins original and transformed policy, fixed systemd/dbus/power-profile executables and units, and the complete supported merged D-Bus/Polkit/udev closure. A self-rehashed forged manifest does not establish trust

The BPF helper accepts one already-held fixed worker cgroup descriptor, performs only repeated ingress/egress BPF_PROG_QUERY observations, drops capabilities before proof delivery and applies an intrinsic command-restricted syscall filter

The independent daemon observer accepts one real process descriptor and one of three compiled roles. It binds actual executable inode/hash, process start, boot, UID/GID, exact unit and original one-second operation deadline, with repeated observations

Both socket-activated helpers authenticate the exact capability-free confined hardware controller. Actual reply credentials and a kernel-attached sender process descriptor identify the helper rather than the PID1 activation listener. The existing credential observer remains capability-free and unchanged

Neither helper accepts a model effect, arbitrary executable/path/PID, policy update, PAM secret, TPM operation, grant, authority receipt or hardware mutation. Post-filter daemon exit uses _exit rather than invoking OpenSSL/libc cleanup handlers
remaining: Join the separately implemented Admin console, finite grants, resource-manager exclusion and protected hardware lifecycle, then pass a strict coherent Rust/source sweep
Verify the image-specific loaded LSM, actual socket activation and sender proof, real device/daemon observations, guarded effects and interruption/recovery on native hardware
Build and independently identify new media before acceptance; this record changes no existing image or gate
